    Transfer Pricing

    Updated 16 months ago

    Flutterwave supports transfers to bank accounts and mobile money users in several countries. The pricing listed below depends on the country where the recipient's bank or mobile money account is domiciled.

    Bank Account

    1% with a minimum fee of 20EGP capped at 25EGP
